page.layout: One printed page: running head at top with page number at top right; text in one column of paragraphs; a heading in small capitals with a centred subtitle; then a two-column list (left column and right column) of ordinal names set in lines; no marginal notes.

main_text.p: Porrò dicimus, vn páio, due páia: vn centináio, due centináia: vn migliáio, due migliáia, &c.
Item: Vna decina, due decine, &c. Vna dozina, due dozine, &c. Vna ventina, due ventine, &c. vna trentina, due trentine, &c.
main_text.head: DE NOMINIB. ORDINEM significantibus.

page.notes: Heading and two-column list lines are set in mixed type; the right column is aligned beside the left by line. Some lines are faint or show-through from the reverse page and are read with [?] where uncertain.
